{{Quote|Something's startling these creatures.''"<br />"''And it's not us.''"<br />"''I feel it too.''"<br />"''A disturbance&hellip; I've got a bad feeling about this.|Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi, upon their arrival on Nelvaan|<ref name="CW22" />}}
'''Horaxes''' were large [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]], [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Species/Legends|creatures]] native to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nelvaan/Legends|Nelvaan]]. Their powerful muscular frames could grow over fifteen [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall. Solitary and territorial, horaxes only gathered in pairs for [[Reproduction/Legends|mating]] purposes or to fight over territory. [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanian]] locals used the scales of the horaxes' tails to make a special [[Horax scale elixir/Legends|elixir]], the scent of which could drive away horaxes for an entire [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the horax population began to decline due to climate change caused by a local [[siphon generator]] operated by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] a horax after being attacked, disrupting the initiation ritual of a [[Tuzes-Adaz's son|young Nelvaanian boy]] in the process.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Horax_tail.png|thumb|left|300px|A horax using its tail to attack]]
Horaxes were large [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] native to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nelvaan/Legends|Nelvaan]]. The [[Limb/Legends|quadrupedal]] [[Species/Legends|creatures]] were capable of growing to heights of over fifteen [[Meter/Legends|meters]],<ref name="DB" /> thanks to the low [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="DB2">{{DB|location|nelvaan|Nelvaan}}</ref> Their powerfully muscled frames were covered in thick, knobby, [[Color/Legends|blue]] skin,<ref name="CWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and they had reddish-orange [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. The [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] of the horax contained many very sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], the most prominent being the four enormous [[Sword/Legends|saber]]-like fangs that protruded from its maw. At the end of the beasts' snouts was a pair of shovel-like horns used to uproot entire [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and split open [[siltcrawler]] burrows, revealing entire hibernating colonies to be eaten. The tail of a horax was long and heavy, lined with sharp spurs, and concluded with a club made of dense [[Bone/Legends|bone]].<ref name="DB" /> The tail was also covered in scales.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|57|horax}}</ref>

==Behavior==
The [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]]<ref name="DB" /> horaxes were solitary creatures.<ref name="CSWE" /> They were also [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]]<ref name="DBnote" /> and were very territorial, using their fangs, horns, and clubbed tails to fight each other for territory and only gathering in pairs to [[Reproduction/Legends|mate]].<ref name="CWCG" /> They preyed upon siltcrawler colonies for [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and were not able to fare well in extreme cold.<ref name="DB" />

==History==
{{Quote|Herald, I bartered away small hunt trophies. Two ghest skins, rack of horax teeth.|Qyzen Fess|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Qyzen Fess|The Scorekeeper's Lesson}}</ref>}}
[[File:Horax.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A horax attacking several clone troopers]]
At some point, the [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanian]] inhabitants of the horaxes' homeworld discovered that a special [[Horax scale elixir/Legends|elixir]] could be made from horax tail scales, the scent of which would repel the massive beasts for an entire [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. It eventually became a customary coming-of-age ritual for young Nelvaanian [[Gender/Legends|boys]] to venture out into the [[Tree/Legends|forests]] and bring back a scale from the tail of a horax, granting them a place among the highest warrior ranks.<ref name="DB" /> The [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] hunter [[Qyzen Fess]], who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], hunted several horaxes during his career.<ref name="TOR" /> During the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Separatist-aligned [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] built a [[Techno Union laboratory|laboratory]] that operated off a [[siphon generator]] that drained the vicinity of thermal energy.<ref name="DB2" /> This plunged the planet into an [[Water/Legends|ice]] age that caused many horaxes to [[Death/Legends|die]], reducing the population to scarcity.<ref name="DB" />

Toward the end of the Clone Wars in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were sent to Nelvaan in search of the notorious [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. Upon arrival, Skywalker, Kenobi, and their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] forces were attacked by a horax, resulting in the death of all the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]]. However, Skywalker managed to kill the horax, though in the process disrupting the coming-of-age ritual of a [[Tuzes-Adaz's son|young Nelvaanian boy]].<ref name="DB2" /> After being taken to the locals' [[City/Legends|village]] of [[Rokrul]], Skywalker was sent to [[Battle of Nelvaan|destroy]] the Techno Union base, as the Nelvaanian [[Shaman/Legends|Shaman]] [[Orvos]] had determined that Skywalker was the [[Holt Kazed]], or "Ghost Hand," of local legend.<ref name="CW23">{{CW|23}}</ref> While traveling through a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] on the way to the base, Skywalker came upon some cave drawings, some of which depicted horaxes. Skywalker then experienced a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] of the future in which the paintings told the story of a Nelvaanian male with a powerful arm destroying enemies, one being a horax attacking his village.<ref name="CW24">{{CW|24}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The horax first appeared in the [[Chapter 22 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|twenty-second chapter]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="CW22" /> which aired on [[March 22]], [[2005]].<ref name="TV.com">{{TVcom|url=shows/star-wars-clone-wars/chapter-xxii-370294|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars - Season 2, Episode 2: Chapter XXII}}</ref> The horax was first named in the audio commentary on the series' [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Volume Two|Volume Two]] DVD.<ref name="Commentary">{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars: Clone Wars Volume Two|episode=Chapter 22 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)}}</ref> Much of the creature was drawn by [[Mike Kim]], though one piece of artwork in the DVD's still gallery misspelled the creature as "Horrax."<ref name="Still Galleries">{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars: Clone Wars Volume Two|featurette=Still Galleries|nolink=1}}</ref>
